ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Always.en: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.
ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Always.fr: Écrasons des BAIES !\n…Ce serait gaspiller des BAIES ?\pOn trouve toujours des BAIES par\nterre dans la FORÊT DES BAIES.

ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Imposs.en: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.
ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Imposs.fr: Il est impossible de SURFER entre\nles îles du coin.\pLes marées sont trop rapides et\ntraîtresses.

ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetw.en: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!
ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetw.fr: Hé, tu as entendu la nouvelle ?\pLe réseau de PC d'ici peut\nmaintenant se connecter aux PC de\lKANTO.\pJe ne sais pas comment c'est\narrivé, mais c'est fantastique !
